<thought>We need a valid SMILES for the target molecule. The correct SMILES is "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1O)C(F)(F)F". Using this, we search the template catalog for templates that break a ketone ('ketones') and an alkene ('C-C double bonds') and form an aliphatic hydroxyl ('aliphatic hydroxyls'). This will give us the template ID(s) needed to generate precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1O)C(F)(F)F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
